title: Saturday run + strength
subtitle: ~45 min · run first, then strength at home · no jumping
feeling: A few easy days, fresh and ready to work hard. Want to sweat and get stronger.
note: Run first to get the sweat going, then two strength blocks. 'lb' means pounds per dumbbell. Pick a weight where the last 2 reps are hard. Skip the one-leg deadlift if your hamstring tugs.

sections.label: 1 · Cardio blast · 10 min run

items.name: Fast / easy intervals
items.cue: Fast = breathing hard, can only say a few words. Easy = jog slow and recover.

sections.instructions: Outside. 3 min easy, then 4 rounds of 1 min fast and 1 min easy.

sections.label: 2 · Warm-up · indoors

items.name: March, hip circles, bodyweight squats
items.cue: Get your hips and legs loose before the weights.

sections.instructions: Grab your dumbbells, a chair and a couch.

sections.label: 3 · Block A · 3 rounds

items.name: Bulgarian split squat
items.cue: Back foot up on a chair. Hold a 20 lb dumbbell in each hand. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then stand up.

items.name: Slow push-up
items.cue: Take 3 seconds to lower your chest to the floor. Knees down is fine.

items.name: One-arm row
items.cue: One 20 lb dumbbell. Free hand on a chair or couch. Pull your elbow back to your hip.

items.name: Hip thrust
items.cue: Upper back on the couch, one 20 lb dumbbell on your hips. Squeeze your glutes at the top.

sections.instructions: Do all 4 moves in a row. Rest 45 seconds. Repeat 3 times.

sections.label: 4 · Block B · 3 rounds

items.name: One-leg deadlift
items.cue: One 20 lb dumbbell. Hinge forward on one leg while the other leg lifts behind you. Go slow.

items.name: Shoulder press
items.cue: A 15 lb dumbbell in each hand. Press straight overhead.

items.name: Slow goblet squat
items.cue: One 20 lb dumbbell held at your chest. Take 4 seconds to lower, pause 1 second at the bottom, then stand.

sections.instructions: Do all 3 moves in a row. Rest 30 seconds. Repeat 3 times.

sections.label: 5 · Sweat finisher

items.name: Dumbbell thruster
items.cue: Two 15 lb dumbbells at your shoulders. Squat down, then stand and press overhead in one smooth motion.

sections.instructions: 40 seconds hard, 20 seconds rest, 4 times. No jumping.

sections.label: 6 · Core · 2 rounds

items.name: Reverse crunch
items.cue: Lie on your back. Bring your knees to your chest and lift your hips a little. Lower slowly.

items.name: Russian twist
items.cue: Sit leaning back slightly, holding a 10 lb dumbbell. Turn side to side.

items.name: Toe taps
items.cue: On your back, legs bent at 90 degrees. Lower one foot to tap the floor, then switch.

sections.instructions: Do all 3 moves in a row. Repeat 2 times.

items.name: Easy walk and stretch
items.cue: Walk slowly, then stretch quads, chest and glutes.
